name: mosaic_estrogen_enterohepatic
description: Estrogen enterohepatic recycling as a kinetic / PK-PD ODE — hepatic conjugation, biliary delivery, microbial beta-glucuronidase deconjugation (estrobolome), and reabsorption. Model authored inline as Antimony (shown in the study's Model tab); the `gus` parameter tunes how strongly the gut microbiome raises systemic estrogen exposure.

tellurium.doc:
Bridge Process wrapping a Tellurium / libroadrunner SBML simulation.

Loads an SBML or Antimony model into a RoadRunner instance and advances
it in chunks of `interval` on each update() call. Returns absolute
species concentrations, reaction rates, parameter values, and the
current time as overwrite values.

SPECIES PORT (important):
  * DEFAULT (``bulk_species=True``): the ``species`` port is a numpy
    ``array[(n,),float]`` ordered by ``getFloatingSpeciesIds`` and moved via
    roadrunner's bulk C API — ~2x faster per update() and bit-identical.
    Wire it to an Array-shaped store, not a dict.
  * COUPLED multi-process composites (two+ processes sharing one species
    store, operator-split): also set ``coupled_species=True`` — the species
    output becomes an ADDITIVE array so the arms' deltas SUM under reconcile
    instead of clobbering, and only the settable subset is written back.
  * LEGACY (``bulk_species=False``): the old per-species ``map[float]`` port;
    slower, kept only for back-compat with dict-shaped species stores.

Config:
    model: Antimony or SBML source string.
    model_format: 'antimony' (default) or 'sbml'.
    model_file: Optional path to a local .ant/.txt/.xml file
        (takes precedence over `model`).
    integrator: 'cvode' (deterministic) or 'gillespie' (stochastic).
    absolute_tolerance: CVODE absolute tolerance.
    relative_tolerance: CVODE relative tolerance.
    seed: Random seed for stochastic integrators (None = unset).
    species_overrides: Mapping of {species_id: initial_value}
        applied after model load.
    parameter_overrides: Mapping of {parameter_id: value}
        applied after model load.
    reset_on_init: If True, call reset() after applying overrides
        (default True).

_contract.summary: Advances a user-authored Antimony/SBML kinetic model one coupling interval by integrating its ODE system dX/dt = f(X, p; t) with libroadrunner (CVODE).

inputs.species: optional incoming floating-species state pushed into roadrunner before the step (numpy array ordered by getFloatingSpeciesIds when bulk_species=True, else a {species_id: value} map); in coupled_species mode this is the shared-store baseline the arm starts from

outputs.species: post-step floating-species state (overwrite; an ADDITIVE delta in coupled_species mode)
outputs.rates: {reaction_id: rate} reaction velocities v at the new state (getReactionRates)
outputs.time: roadrunner current time after the step

config.model_file: optional path to a local .ant/.txt/.xml model (takes precedence over model)
config.seed: random seed for stochastic integrators (-1 = unset)
config.bulk_species: species port as a numpy Array via roadrunner's bulk C API (default True) vs a legacy map[float]
config.coupled_species: operator-split mode: additive species deltas that SUM under multi-process reconcile
config.conserved_moiety_analysis: let roadrunner slave moiety-dependent species to conservation laws

math: \frac{dX}{dt} = f(X,\, p;\, t) = S\, v(X,\, p)
v = v(X,\, p) \quad\text{(reaction-rate vector returned on the } \texttt{rates} \text{ port)}

symbols.X: floating-species state vector (concentrations by default, or amounts), ordered by getFloatingSpeciesIds
symbols.p: global kinetic parameters of the model
symbols.\\Delta t: coupling interval advanced per update() call
symbols.f: ODE right-hand side assembled by libroadrunner from the model's reactions
symbols.X^{(i)}: the i-th coupled arm's post-step state in operator-split (coupled_species) mode

assumptions: Deterministic CVODE (BDF) integration by default; stiffness is handled internally by CVODE. Set integrator='gillespie' for stochastic SSA.
The reaction network is user-authored (Antimony/SBML) and loaded at build time, so this contract specifies the integration and port semantics, not any specific reaction equations.
Species are reported as concentrations unless the model yields amounts; the state vector is ordered by getFloatingSpeciesIds.
update() is stateful across intervals (roadrunner carries state between calls); the Step variants reset each firing instead.
coupled_species assumes a Lie/Jacobi operator split across processes sharing one species store; each arm emits its own delta and the deltas sum under reconcile.
references: Somogyi et al. (2015) libRoadRunner: a high performance SBML simulation and analysis library.
Hindmarsh et al. (2005) SUNDIALS: CVODE stiff/non-stiff ODE integration.
